description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure: it is the publisher's system-generated "Check for updates" button (Crossref-style update icon) that appears in the margin of journal articles. On a light grey gradient square, a circular arrow ring made of alternating yellow-gold and teal-blue arc segments surrounds a solid red banner/bookmark shape that points downward and is notched at its lower edge. Below the graphic, the words "Check for updates" are printed on two lines in black sans-serif type. There are no panels, axes, units, scale bars, legends, data points, micrographs, spectra or annotations of any kind, and therefore no material system, composition, processing condition or measurement is shown. The image carries no information about the 30Mn-13Al-1.3C-5Cr duplex low-density steel discussed in the paper; it is an editorial artefact rather than a data-bearing figure. Consequently the group's scientific role, claim and any quantitative anchors cannot be determined from this image, and no panel-by-panel decomposition is possible.
